defs.def: to plant or spread seeds in or on the ground 播种；种

ex.s: Over thousands of years，they began to depend less on ___57___ could be hunted or gathered from the wild，and more on animals they had raised and crops they had sown.
ex.t: 农业比狩猎和采集每人生产更多的食物   ___58___ 所以人们能够抚养更多的孩子。

defs.def: to introduce or spread feelings or ideas, especially ones that cause trouble 灌输；激起；散布；煽动

ex.s: These letters obviously helped sow the seeds of love between the two.
ex.t: 这些信件显然在两人之间播下了爱的种子。

ex.s: Sow the seeds of success today and your harvest will be great tomorrow.
ex.t: 今天播下成功的种子，明天你的收获将会丰厚。
